svg.title: A weekly timesheet: my logged time across teams, by day — SoftTrack web design mockup (#267)
svg.desc: Time logged shows on the ticket, in a sprint’s report and in a team’s report, and none of them shows one person’s week. A grid sets tickets against days, across every team the person is on, with totals per day and week; typing in a cell logs the time; and a team’s admins see the same grid with a row per person.

svg.text: Done when a week is a grid of tickets against days across every team the person is on, typing in a cell creates or changes the worklog, a ticket is added by searching, a day with
nothing logged and a day over a set number of hours are marked, team admins see their team’s week, a manager sees their reports on shared teams, and a week exports as CSV.
